plainTranslation: Opposite by nature, drawn together for it. One leads with identity, the other with feeling, and you complete and irritate each other in equal measure. Failure mode: keeping score, or swinging between fusion and friction. Trade roles on purpose, value the contrast, and stop tallying who gave more.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryShort: Their direction and your needs keep pulling different ways.
summaryDeep: Their direction and your needs keep pulling different ways. Their confidence can unsettle your comfort. Name what you need out loud instead of quietly adjusting around them.
tension: The problem is that it can turn into a standoff. One person feels unseen. The other feels like nothing they do is enough.
advice: Don't make it a competition over whose needs matter more. Say what you need, listen to what they need, and meet somewhere in the middle.
